author: NingMeng123
history: BloodMoonInvasion.highestDay persisted highest primary-world calendar date
blood_count: highestDay / 32 - highestDay / 128 using integer division; blue dates excluded
stage: Use the highest saved world day for ordinary, blood and blue dates. Leather starts at day 16, chainmail at 32, gold/copper/silver at 48, iron at 64, ancient metal at 96, mithril at 112, adamantium at 128 and vibranium at 144. Stage rows retain blood_start_day as the shared calendar threshold and blood_moon_counts as the first default blood moon at that stage, when one occurs. Vibranium is the stage from the fourth blood moon onward.
ordinary_armor_probability: Whole-set acceptance: blood_armor_probability / 2 at the same highest-date stage; legacy entrance 30% before day 16
blood_armor_probability: Per initially empty armor slot: (80 + 2 * stage) / 100; independent acceptance and accepted-slot material rolls from day 16 onward. The first default blood moon on day 32 uses stage 1 and an 82% per-slot chance.
material_weight: center=material_grades[stage]; gradeWeight(g)=g<center ? lower^(center-g) : higher^(g-center); divide each grade weight between its materials. At stage 3, redistribute the combined gold, copper and silver weight of 27/20 equally (9/20 each).
material_probability: Ordinary and blood dates use the same normalized weights. Copper and silver share their grade; stage 3 also gives gold the same weight as copper and silver. All ten materials remain possible.
overall_material_probability: Ordinary: whole-set acceptance times conditional material chance for each initially empty slot. Blood: independent single-slot acceptance times material chance. Every ordinary per-slot material marginal is exactly half the same highest-date blood marginal.
probability_oracle: Independent Python fractions.Fraction fixture with nine grades and ten material columns [0,1,2,3,3,4,5,6,7,8], shared ratios 7/20 and 2/5, equal redistribution in stage 3, and ordinary acceptance factor 1/2. No production Java or random-selection implementation is imported.
equipment_policy: New eligible humanoid monsters only. Persist each spawn decision including empty results. Ordinary dates use one whole-set acceptance/material roll, with acceptance half the same highest-date blood rate and the same material weights. Blood dates independently roll each empty slot. Before day 16, use source materials and partial stopping with 30% ordinary entrance and 60% legacy first blood entrance for an early addon calendar. Preserve fixed equipment floors, explicit stacks, source quality/wear, existing decisions and loaded entities. Calendar enchantment growth and enchanted natural-gear drop penalties are separate shared generation/drop rules.
ordinary_held_probability: Empty-main-hand supplementation only: blood_held_probability / 2 at the same highest-date stage
held_equipment_policy: Applicable melee humanoids with an empty main hand only; preserve existing weapons and ranged mobs. Draw held-equipment acceptance separately from armor. Prefer the first armor piece newly filled in head/chest/legs/feet order, otherwise recognize existing armor, otherwise draw an independent material. Sword, pickaxe, shovel and axe have equal type weights; leather/chain tiers fall back to rusted iron tools.

held_equipment.eligible: newly joined Zombie family or R196Undead with an empty main hand after source initialization
held_equipment.material: Prefer the first newly generated armor piece, then recognized existing armor; otherwise draw independently from the shared highest-date material distribution.
held_equipment.existing_mainhand: preserve exact item stack, including native/generated and explicit items; no additional draw
held_equipment.excluded: skeleton family and fixed-equipment source mobs; all non-humanoid mobs
held_equipment.generation: R196MobEquipment.generated once per new stack, retaining source quality/wear with calendar enchantment growth; death-drop policy is separate.
held_equipment.persistence: armor decision version 3 with four-slot armor_tiers array, and independent held compound version 1; success, rejection and preserved outcomes recorded once; all old armor decisions and loaded incomplete decisions never receive new items

ordinary_calendar_progression.progress: Use the material stage unlocked by the highest saved calendar day. Shared thresholds apply on ordinary, blood and blue dates. The day 15 anchor describes the bounded probability helper; actual pre-day-16 spawns use the legacy equipment path.
ordinary_calendar_progression.material_interpolation: New ordinary spawns use the integer calendar stage. Compatible fractional API inputs blend adjacent shared normalized distributions.
ordinary_calendar_progression.history: Persisted highest primary-world calendar date; time rewind and dimensions do not lower it. Blue dates use ordinary equipment acceptance with the material stage of the saved highest date.
ordinary_calendar_progression.blood_comparison: For each highest date from day 16 and each material, ordinary per-empty-slot armor and empty-main-hand supplement probabilities are exactly half their blood-date counterparts. Whole-suit and at-least-one-piece probabilities differ because ordinary acceptance is shared across slots. Native weapons, fixed sets and shield generation remain independent.
ordinary_calendar_progression.quality_unchanged: Preserve source quality/wear, fixed equipment floors and explicit main hands. Calendar enchantment growth and death-drop policy apply separately.

blood_unarmored_chance_compatibility: The stage-row blood_unarmored_chance key is retained as an alias for blood_empty_slot_chance=1-p. It is not the chance of a completely unarmored mob; that is blood_all_empty_armor_chance=(1-p)^4.

blood_armor_slot_policy.acceptance: Independently test armorChance(stage,true) once for every initially empty slot; rejected slots stay empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.material: Each accepted slot independently selects from the current blood-stage material distribution; mixed-material armor is expected
blood_armor_slot_policy.all_empty_probability: (1-p)^4 when all four slots started empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.all_four_probability: p^4 when all four slots started empty; materials may differ
blood_armor_slot_policy.existing_equipment: Preserve existing slot contents exactly; aggregate probabilities apply only when all four slots were empty
blood_armor_slot_policy.first_blood_date: Preserve legacy 60% acceptance, legacy material pool and partial-armor stop rules
